## Different directions on research
---
There are some other pathways we can follow in making withering effective.
1. Using IR rays instead of using Dendro Thermal power aka. **Saving energy**.

> [!warning]
> Not sure if Industry 5.0 !!

2. Decision making on when to stop the machine while continuously monitoring the **moisture content**/ controlling **temp**.
3. Tea Plucking (I mostly found related to *automation*).

## Terms
---
**Dendro thermal power** is electricity generated by burning **woody biomass** (like wood chips, sawdust, or energy crops) in a thermal power plant, using heat to create steam that drives turbines, similar to coal plants but using sustainable wood fuel.

## Research
---
[[@Daiki2011|Application of Fourier transform near-infrared spectroscopy to optimization of green tea steaming process conditions]] (probably not Industry 5.0) is about using near IR to get best temperatures using mathematical models. This research was done for Japanese green tea. This might be helpful though.

[[@Zeyi2017|Impact of light irradiation on black tea quality during withering]] is about what color/ type of light used increases the quality, aroma and taste. Found here that ==yellow== light is more suitable.
